title: display name: an entity yields none (empty string)
_note: Arm 3 of Client.deriveDisplayName [Client.java:457-481]: an ENTITY contributes no joined name and the display name is the empty string, even when all three parts are present. Transcribed from capture .softhouse/capture/parties-display-name/out/OHNAMECAP-E1-m-client.json (read-only SELECT of m_client id 15, tenant gerege): firstname=Байгууллага, middlename=Туршилтын, lastname=Жишээ, fullname=null, display_name="", legal_form_enum=2. The same client's GET /clients/15 omits the displayName key entirely; that face is recorded in OHNAMECAP-E1-raw.json. This seam grades the empty string (see Expect's EMPTY vs ABSENT note).

provenance.note: Transcribed from the committed capture .softhouse/capture/parties-display-name/out/OHNAMECAP-E1-m-client.json; capture_case_id is the exact display_name field of the observed m_client row, present and empty, corroborating legal_form_enum=2.
